During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], an '''Ewok''' was a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. During an infiltration of an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] facility alongside a [[Unidentified smuggler (Alliance)|smuggler]] and some others, the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] was disguised in an [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droid]] while the others wore [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|stormtrooper armor]]. The Ewok used a [[Flute/Legends|flute]] to make [[Droid/Legends|droid]] noises.<ref name="RPG" />
